checks.title: Thieu payment method/payment info hop le -> canCreateByUser=false ngay, khong xet tiep

checks.expected_result: canCreateByUser = false, bat ke cac dieu kien khac co thoa man hay khong (khong xet tiep dieu kien bo sung).
